content.short: Hivemapper is a decentralized mapping network on Solana where users earn HONEY for 4K dashcam imagery collection.
content.description: Hivemapper is a decentralized mapping network (DePIN) built on Solana that rewards contributors for collecting street-level imagery. Using specialized 4K dashcams, drivers around the world map their surroundings and earn HONEY tokens. This community-driven approach creates a fresher and more accurate map than traditional centralized services. The platform leverages blockchain to ensure all mapping data is verified and transparently rewarded. Hivemapper’s model reduces map maintenance costs while empowering individuals to build a global geospatial resource collaboratively.
